entries.intro: Contract development of high-load backend and fullstack solutions for fintech, crypto, and B2B clients. Each project covers the full cycle: architecture from scratch — development — shipping the MVP to production — handover to the client's team.

subSections.heading: Client: Finam — dedicated R&D / product group
Project 1 — Crypto analytics platform with an AI chat
bullets: Designed and built a high-load backend on Node.js/Nest.js (microservices, Apache Kafka inter-service bus) processing events from exchange streams

Implemented real-time data collection over REST/WebSocket from exchanges plus aggregation of external sources (CoinMarketCap, Messari, DeFiLlama, CoinGecko); normalized heterogeneous streams into a single model
Built storage on PostgreSQL (transactions) + ClickHouse (time series)
Developed an AI module for personalized recommendations (AI SDK / LLM) on top of the user's portfolio and market data
Integrated with Ethereum-network smart contracts (JSON-RPC / WebSocket RPC, Solidity)
Result: the MVP shipped to production and was handed over to the product team.
subSections.stack: Node.js, Nest.js, TypeScript, Next.js, React, Zustand, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Prisma, Redis, WebSocket, JSON-RPC, Ethers.js, AI SDK, LLM, Claude Code, Cursor, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD.

subSections.heading: Project 2 — Prediction market (Polymarket/Kalshi-like) for influencers
bullets: Architected the system from scratch: microservices + smart contracts (event creation, bet acceptance, payout calculation), a unified API for 3 clients — web (React/Next.js), mobile (React Native), Telegram Mini App
Implemented crypto wallet connection (MetaMask, WalletConnect, Unisat, Phantom) and handling of on-chain contract events
PostgreSQL — user data; ClickHouse — activity analytics and rankings; DevOps pipelines (Docker/K8s/CI-CD)
Result: launched an MVP for web/mobile/Telegram with shared business logic and security.
subSections.stack: Node.js, Nest.js, TypeScript, React, React Native, Next.js, Solidity, Ethers.js, web3, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, AI SDK, LLM, Claude Code, Cursor.

subSections.heading: Client: Biocad — internal high-load B2B platform

bullets: Designed a fault-tolerant architecture from scratch (client + server) for the high loads of a business-critical internal tool
Carried out deep refactoring of the DB schema and queries (PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB) for large volumes, which helped reduce server load
Modernized the legacy codebase, covered critical modules with unit/integration tests, set up CI/CD
Result: the solution was delivered and put into operation.
subSections.stack: Node.js, Nest.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, Prisma, Kafka, Socket.io, Redis, Jest, Supertest, Docker, Kubernetes.
